test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 29 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following features of the Constitution of India has been taken from the Government of India Act, 1935?

options.text: Suspension of Fundamental Rights during Emergency
Joint Sitting of the Two Houses of Parliament

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Federal Plan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Government of India Act, 1935** laid the foundation for the federal structure in India.
 
• It introduced the concept of a **Federal Plan**, dividing powers between the **Central Government** and the **Provincial Governments**.
 
• The Act provided for three lists of subjects: the **Federal List**, the **Provincial List**, and the **Concurrent List**, which were later incorporated into the **Indian Constitution**.
 
• The Federal Plan established the principle of division of powers, which is now a key feature of India's **Constitutional framework.**
 
• The Act also introduced the system of **autonomy for provinces**, marking the beginning of decentralization in governance.
 
• This federal structure continues to be a significant feature of the **Constitution of India**, as seen in Articles related to the division of powers and responsibilities between the **Union and the States**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Suspension of Fundamental Rights during Emergency**__

 __
 
• The provision for the **suspension of Fundamental Rights** during an emergency is derived from the **Weimar Constitution of Germany**, not the Government of India Act, 1935.
 
• In India, it is specifically provided under **Article 359** of the Constitution.
 
• This mechanism allows the President to suspend the enforcement of Fundamental Rights during a **national emergency.**
 
 
 
• **Joint Sitting of the Two Houses of Parliament**__
 __
 
• The concept of a **Joint Sitting** is derived from the **Australian Constitution**.
 
• In India, it is mentioned under **Article 108** of the Constitution.
 
• It is convened to resolve disagreements between the **Lok Sabha** and **Rajya Sabha** over a particular bill.
 
 
 
• **The Idea of a Republic**__
 
 
• The idea of India being a **Republic** was inspired by the **French Revolution**.
 
• A Republic signifies a form of government where the head of the state is elected, rather than a hereditary monarch.
 
• This concept is reflected in the **Preamble** of the Indian Constitution.
